svg.title: Gas Dehydration
svg.text: KY-501 is one logic function drawn at each valve it strokes; the sequence is KC-501.
Cycle: 8 h adsorption, 5 h heating, 2 h cooling, 1 h standby. AAH-502 shortens the adsorption step.
V-501A and V-501B are identical vessels. Neither drawing says which is on line; the sequence does.
